remaining_validation: Full native final suite and exact aggregate03 HTTP/restart run were pending when this scoped tooling review was written.
Final human review of opt-in authentication behavior and all security-sensitive source changes remains required.

resolved_findings.finding: Witness strings alone could accept an error body as a GIS positive control.
resolved_findings.resolution: Strict FeatureCollection with one Point [1,2] and exact label; marker echoes, null/empty/wrong geometry and duplicate JSON members fail.

resolved_findings.finding: Case-sensitive Location lookup could miss a redirect.
resolved_findings.resolution: Normalize response headers; negative regression covers lowercase location.

resolved_findings.finding: Final exception receipt could write fixture secrets after file scanning.
resolved_findings.resolution: Recursively sanitize the complete receipt before exclusive write; redactions force failure.

resolved_findings.finding: Scrub/digest errors could bypass final HTTP failure receipt; reader failure could be missed after a positive log control.
resolved_findings.resolution: Best-effort finalization preserves errors, joins log readers, records capture failures and writes a failed receipt; tests reach actual child failure paths.

resolved_findings.finding: Selected-target native execution alone did not guarantee new injected regressions ran.
resolved_findings.resolution: Require every injected suite with exact declared case count, no missing/repeated suite or new skips.

resolved_findings.finding: Earlier aggregate logging WAR lacked repaired OAuth sources.
resolved_findings.resolution: Fresh build, full library/file/class inventories and exact compiler-to-WAR identities; final stateless candidate additionally requires @Transient nested context class.

resolved_findings.finding: Worker reuse was inferred from pool size.
resolved_findings.resolution: Passive native Jetty request telemetry proves mixed positive/negative decisions on reused workers without changing responses.

reviewed_boundaries: Only the exact new WAR is copied into fresh runtime artifact directory; loaded application class origins are checked against extracted WAR JAR hashes.
No inherited data directory is activated; loaded fixture user/group role authority and stateless option are read back.
Fresh credential negatives require actual verifier calls. Parallel counter windows may overlap and must not be interpreted as per-request verifier attribution.
Nonzero cache reuse and later expiry are tested separately; immediate revocation is not claimed.
Denied administration operations have privileged state readbacks and same-route positive controls.
Application and synthetic identity endpoint use retained loopback supervisor; owned PostgreSQL is outside supervisor after measured setsid denial, with its limitation explicitly recorded.
Source/legal/production security closure is not granted by these harness or artifact checks.
scope: Independent review of root HTTP harness and other-agent runtime/fixture; author validation of packaging/evidence helpers and their regressions.
